issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'בְּכָל שָׁאטְךָ בְּנֶפֶשׁ' means 'with all your contempt/scorn in your soul' (i.e., with all your soul's contempt), but the Chinese renders it as '以性命歡喜' (rejoice with your life/soul), which changes the meaning from 'contempt' to 'life/soul' as the object of rejoicing. The Hebrew 'שָׁאטְךָ' (your contempt/scorn) is not represented; instead 'נֶפֶשׁ' (soul) is taken as the instrument of rejoicing, whereas in Hebrew it is the soul that harbors the contempt.
